patterns.name: unknown-destination-bulk
patterns.condition: Outbound transfer >=50MB to newly seen destination, with file batch, archive or repeated copying
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: exfiltration over alternate protocol plus novel destination and large volume

patterns.name: offhours-archive-transfer
patterns.condition: An >=50MB archive sent outside work/class hours to a newly seen address
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: suspicious external archive egress after business hours

patterns.name: repeated-bulk-egress
patterns.condition: High-volume outbound transfer >=50MB repeated at least five times to a destination
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1041: repeated data movement over command-and-control or another communication channel

patterns.name: unusual-port-egress
patterns.condition: High-volume multi-file outbound transfer >=50MB over a port not normally used
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1048: abnormal transfer protocol or port with substantial outgoing volume

patterns.name: full-collection-export
patterns.condition: At least 100 documents or whole vault copied outside in >=50MB burst
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1041: bulk collection egress over a communications channel

patterns.name: exfil-review
patterns.condition: Unverified destination, uncommon transfer, archive or T1041/T1048 tag without sufficient combined evidence
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1041 and T1048: partial indicators need investigation, not automatic block
